description.narrative: (Egypt): The Literate Village activity supports primary school children and their mothers in targeted communities to gain the literacy and life skills for continuous learning and self-improvement. Since it began in 2017, the activity has developed a proven approach to improve literacy by addressing the literacy of both primary school-aged children and their mothers. For example, beneficiary students have demonstrated larger reading gains than a control group on 10 of 11 reading subtasks. Beneficiary students answered 43 percent more reading comprehension questions at the end-line compared with baseline, whereas non-intervention students improved their reading comprehension by 27 percent. Using FY 2021 funding, Literate Village will expand its intervention to Minya governorate to benefit an additional 1,928 villages, 54,072 students, and 50,128 adult learners. In addition, funds will support the final year of implementation in Assiut governorate, which was not able to complete its full cycle of intergenerational instruction due to closures during the COVID-19 pandemic.
